patterns.title: Recurring Cold-Chain Excursions on NH-16 Coastal Corridor
patterns.evidence: 4.2 hour continuous compressor thermal failure logged on Reefer AP-07-TJ-4421, reaching 18.5°C.
patterns.recommendedInvestigation: Audit FastTrack ColdTrans fleet maintenance records and evaluate refrigeration backup alternators.

patterns.title: Severe Organophosphate Chemical Residue in Kurnool Leafy Greens
patterns.route: Adoni -> Guntur Central Cold Hub -> Retailers
patterns.evidence: Chlorpyrifos detected at 0.42 mg/kg (MRL 0.05 mg/kg). Downstream distribution spans 2 supermarkets.
patterns.recommendedInvestigation: Examine agrochemical sprayer calibration and verify organic certification compliance at Tungabhadra Collective.

patterns.title: Weighbridge Inbound Quantity Inflation (+9%) at Chittoor Depot
patterns.evidence: Dispatched weight was 5000 kg, but intake weighbridge recorded 5450 kg without supporting documentation.
patterns.recommendedInvestigation: Inspect load cell calibration on Depot Scale #2 and cross-check driver bill of lading.

patterns.title: Dispatch Timestamp Inversions at Tenali Farm Gate
patterns.route: Tenali Collection Centre -> Guntur Cold Hub
patterns.evidence: Transfer dispatch logged 4.5 hours prior to recorded farm harvest time.
patterns.recommendedInvestigation: Check farm mobile device NTP clock synchronization and investigate pre-booking transfer practices.
